issues.title: Viewport edge collision and content obscuration
issues.description: Dropdown overlays section headers and touches the right screen boundary.
issues.evidence: Menu obscures 'Alert filt' and 'Choose whi' headings and hugs the right viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Add boundary padding and constrain menu position relative to its activator.
issues.triageNote: Content obscuration is composition (page forces menu open via defaultOpen on a dense phone page — same pattern on pair-007/148/155). Edge-hugging NOT reproduced: measured menu keeps 8–16px gap from the right viewport edge with Radix avoidCollisions (no overflow) on 360/390px phones. Real component-level nit: when a collision does occur, Radix clamps flush to the edge with collisionPadding=0 (truly touching); added collisionPadding={8} default to DropdownMenuContent/SubContent so collision-clamped menus keep an 8px boundary inset (consumer-overridable).

issues.title: Inconsistent menu item text alignment
issues.description: Menu items have uneven left margins due to missing icon alignment slots.
issues.evidence: 'Snap to grid' text is left-aligned to the container edge while surrounding items are indented with icons.
issues.suggestion: Provide consistent icon indentation spacing across all menu items in the group.
issues.triageNote: LTR evidence contradicted by measurement: 'Snap to grid' text x=181px exactly matches icon-item text x=181px (indicator at 157px = icon slot), so LTR alignment is correct — auditor misread. Real underlying defect is the same physical-prop pattern context-menu had: pl-8/pr-2/left-2/ml-auto don't mirror in RTL (checkbox/radio text would sit 8px from the start edge while icon items indent 32px). Applied the same logical-prop fix (ps-8/pe-2/start-2/ms-auto) for RTL correctness and cross-component consistency.
